description: Delete an AS-path list in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. An AS-path list used by a route policy or an InterCXP route policy is refused as in use. A list still held by rules of route policies pending deletion is marked for deletion instead of removed. The delete removes it from the configuration at once. If it was deployed, the network keeps it until the deletion is provisioned from the Alkira portal. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

id.description: Id of the AS-path list, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The list_as_path_get_* read tools and list_as_path_create return it.

name: list_as_path_delete
